chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man about 25, short black curly hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with white drawstrings and black joggers
chars.FRIEND: a Moroccan man about 30, shaved head, thick black beard, wearing a dark-green work apron over a white t-shirt and blue jeans
chars.GIRL: a young Moroccan woman, long dark hair in a loose ponytail, wearing a long lilac cardigan over a cream dress and white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small cluttered t-shirt printing shop in a Casablanca neighbourhood, FRIEND proudly pulls a freshly printed plain t-shirt off a heat press machine while NARRATOR leans on the counter watching, impressed. Medium shot, both faces visible, warm light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: FRIEND holds up a t-shirt printed with a big colourful cartoon portrait (no letters), grinning and showing it off to NARRATOR who laughs. Print shop with shirts hanging on the walls.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: FRIEND reaches out his open hand, curious, asking for NARRATOR's smartphone; NARRATOR hesitantly hands it over. Close medium shot in the print shop, faces visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: FRIEND bursts out laughing, bent over, pointing at the phone screen (screen seen from the back), while NARRATOR stands embarrassed with his hand on his forehead. Comic expressions, print shop.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on a worn sofa in a small Moroccan living room at night, frowning and scrolling on his phone, piles of unsold clothes in plastic bags around him. Phone screen faces away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits cross-legged on his bed in his room, typing quickly on his phone with a sly mischievous grin and raised eyebrow, lit by the phone glow. Phone screen faces away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A narrow Casablanca derb street in the afternoon: GIRL walks home carrying a bread bag, calm, while several young men leaning on a wall in the background all turn their heads to stare at her, admiring. Comic, light mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of NARRATOR holding a bouquet of red roses up to his phone camera to take a photo, tongue out in concentration, in his small room. Phone seen from the side.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands in his room proudly holding his phone up like a trophy, big confident smile, pointing at it with his other hand. Phone screen faces away from the viewer.
